name: LDEM_80S_80MPP_ADJ.TIF
coverage: South polar region; projected bounds -304000 to 304000 metres
source_product_frame: MOON_ME (JPL DE421), as stated by NASA PGDA product information
frame_provenance_note: NASA PGDA Product 90 states MOON_ME (JPL DE421). The project owner reported on 2026-11-15 that M2 confirmed the local raster coordinates are MOON_ME and that the embedded IAU:30135 datum label is erroneous/alias. M3 uses the numeric south-polar projection parameters from the local WKT with MOON_ME input coordinates; no transformation has been applied to raster coordinates. This is an internal M2 sign-off, not a publisher-corrected WKT or checksum match.
verification_scope: Product identity, MOON_ME frame interpretation, and published vertical units are verified; retrieval date and product version remain unknown.

projection_parameters.parameter_source: Observed numeric parameters in the local GeoTIFF WKT; datum label is not used.

limitations: Terrain smaller than the DEM resolution may not be represented.
Slope and roughness results are preliminary and cannot certify landing safety.
Horizon sampling uses nearest-pixel sampling without interpolation.
Missing DEM coverage or no-data pixels must not be estimated.
Results are preliminary student-project decision support, not an official NASA product.
